description.sub_name: 數位敘事：線上策展X社會影響力
description.sub_ename: DIGITAL STORYTELLING: ONLINE CURATION X SOCIAL IMPACT
description.describe_ch: 本課程結合「社會創新」與「數位敘事」的概念，透過AR（擴增實境）技術，探索如何以創新方式傳達非營利組織的理念與社會議題。學生將學習AR互動設計、數位內容策展與視覺溝通技巧，並以團隊專案形式，為真實非營利組織規劃與執行一場線上AR策展。課程強調跨域合作與實作導向，讓學生在創造沉浸式故事體驗的同時，思考科技如何強化社會溝通與影響力，實踐以創意行動推動永續價值。
description.describe_eh: This course integrates social innovation and digital storytelling through Augmented Reality (AR) technology. Students will explore how AR can be used to communicate social issues and nonprofit missions in engaging and impactful ways. The course covers AR interaction design, digital curation, and visual communication, culminating in a team project that develops an online AR exhibition for a nonprofit organization. Emphasizing interdisciplinary collaboration and practical application, the course encourages students to create immersive storytelling experiences that enhance social communication and drive positive impact.
